"""Bind already completed checks to the exact implementation commit."""
import ast
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/workspace/scratch/d417066aafa8/agent-dev-kit')
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = '15fa31d1a3f994a516d5a9003edaadd1295c74b5'
COMMIT = '22c2dc2b6d398e49afee675f339040ff612a271e'
RELATIVE = 'tests/test_skill_command_examples.py'


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


before = git('show', f'{BASE}:{RELATIVE}')
after = git('show', f'{COMMIT}:{RELATIVE}')
assert digest(before) == json.loads((OUT / 'baseline.json').read_text())['sha256']
assert digest(after) == 'a17791efaf2ad0dd7b0923dc49b4c219df0a3eb563495b419cc9de281cb12fc0'
patch = git('diff', '--binary', BASE, COMMIT, '--', RELATIVE)
target = OUT / 'implementation.patch'
assert not target.exists()
target.write_bytes(patch)
checks = {}
for name in ('red-ninja', 'green-runner-1', 'green-module-1', 'ruff-1',
             'red-late-status', 'green-module-final', 'ruff-final'):
    path = OUT / name / 'result.json'
    result = json.loads(path.read_text())
    checks[name] = {'result': result, 'result_sha256': digest(path.read_bytes())}


def declarations(source):
    text = source.decode()
    return {node.name: ast.get_source_segment(text, node)
            for node in ast.parse(text).body if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))}


old, new = declarations(before), declarations(after)
allowed = {'owned_process_snapshot', 'run_example', 'CommandExampleRunnerTests'}
preserved = {name: digest(text.encode()) for name, text in old.items() if name not in allowed}
assert all(new[name] == old[name] for name in preserved)


def ninja_test(source):
    text = source.decode()
    tree = ast.parse(text)
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == (
                'test_real_ninja_child_group_is_observed_and_cleaned_without_touching_another_session'):
            return ast.get_source_segment(text, node)
    raise AssertionError('Ninja acceptance missing')


assert ninja_test((OUT / 'red-ninja/source-before.py').read_bytes()) == ninja_test(after)
report = {
    'recorded_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'implementer': 'ai/implement-session-cleanup',
    'independent_review_claimed': False,
    'base': BASE, 'implementation_commit': COMMIT,
    'source': RELATIVE, 'baseline_sha256': digest(before), 'final_sha256': digest(after),
    'final_bytes': len(after), 'patch_sha256': digest(patch),
    'changed_paths': git('diff', '--name-only', BASE, COMMIT).decode().splitlines(),
    'checks': checks, 'final_module_tests': 52, 'final_module_skipped': 0,
    'ninja_red_acceptance_unchanged_in_green': True,
    'unchanged_declarations_sha256': preserved,
    'preserved_limits': {'default_work_seconds': 15, 'total_cleanup_seconds': 1,
                         'snapshot_seconds': 0.05, 'snapshot_entries': 256, 'snapshot_records': 16},
    'changes': [
        'Observe the owned SID, including Ninja child groups, without argv/environment reads.',
        'Check PID/SID/start_ticks after opening pidfd before sending the exact process SIGKILL.',
        'Keep the Popen leader unreaped during session cleanup; bound all cleanup by one deadline.',
        'Report incomplete, missing, unsupported or changed identities conservatively.',
        'Preserve original outer-group fallback and timeout even after a late diagnostic exception.',
        'Count initial identity collection within the original whole-work deadline.',
    ],
    'negative_results': [
        'Original real Ninja acceptance: two subtest failures, missed leaf and live leaf after complete.',
        'Initial repair late-status exception escaped timeout; actual RED retained and fixed before freeze.',
        'Earlier successful checks remain historical; final proof binds a17791ef source only.',
    ],
    'not_claimed': [
        'Historical hosted ADC/CMake 15-second timeout root cause remains UNKNOWN.',
        'No full suite, CI rerun, release, Root promotion, native runtime or device qualification by this implementer.',
        'Owned-session cleanup is not arbitrary process-tree isolation for descendants calling setsid.',
        'Local Ninja is 1.11.1.git.kitware.jobserver-1; no claim of actual hosted binary verification.',
    ],
}
result_path = OUT / 'implementation-report.json'
assert not result_path.exists()
result_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
index = []
for path in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')):
    if path.is_file() and path.name != 'evidence-index.json':
        data = path.read_bytes()
        index.append({'path': str(path.relative_to(OUT)), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': digest(data)})
(OUT / 'evidence-index.json').write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'report_sha256': digest(result_path.read_bytes()),
                  'index_sha256': digest((OUT / 'evidence-index.json').read_bytes()),
                  'preserved_declarations': len(preserved), 'files': len(index)}, indent=2))
